method: Annual median price per m2 for identical apt_id and area_m2_key, >=5 trades in each year; average log return within complex, then equal complex weights. Chain annual matched returns. >=30 complexes each year for period summary.
limitations: Not an official price index; changing matched sample, survivor and turnover bias
No adjustment for floor, renovation or within-year transaction timing
Source completeness and apt_id stability not independently established
2026 excluded from full-year chart; no extrapolation
Prices are in source deal_amount units; returns unit-invariant
